items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We worked together with a band that was led by Oscar Pettiford

ctx.x: Could one look at this as perhaps the impetus to form the group that you did with Benny?

That was part of it. Prior to forming the Jazztet, Benny had left the Jazz Messengers and was living in New York. We had run into each other on various other gigs. We worked together with a band that was led by Oscar Pettiford, a great bassist…
Excuse me, who else was in that band?
